text: Kaa hara ɗii feddeeji wasorayɗi ko woni kon ka majji sikku wonndema ko Men okki ɓe kon immore e jawle ɗen e ɓiɗɓe ɓen ka ngurnda aduna ɗum ko yaccinanngol ɓe moƴƴere nde ɓe hanndi e mu'un?! Fiyaake on wonah no ɓe sikkirta non, anndu Meɗen okka ɓe ɗum fuuntirgol e ɗaynugol ɓe, kono kamɓe ɓe alaa so'ude ɗum.
